what: A 24-hour hackathon entry: a web app that shows students which study rooms on campus are free right now, and lets them say 'I'm here' so others see a room filling up.
users: Students on our campus, on their phones. The hackathon judges, during a 3-minute pitch and demo.
mustHaves: A map or list of study rooms with free/busy status
Check in to a room and check out
A 3-minute pitch with a live demo at hour 24
niceToHaves: Notifications when a favourite room is free
deadline: 24 hours from the start of the hackathon, pitch at hour 24
outsideRules: Judges score impact, the demo, and technical execution
Everything must be built during the 24 hours
notes: There is no real room-booking data from the university; we only have a PDF list of room names and buildings.
